scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix samvada-backend && npm install --prefix samvada-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,URLS" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" "cd samvada-backend && npm run start:dev" "cd samvada-frontend && npm run dev" "node scripts/print-urls.js"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix samvada-backend && npm run build --prefix samvada-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,URLS" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" "cd samvada-backend && npm run start:prod" "cd samvada-frontend && npm run preview" "node scripts/print-urls.js"
